instruction: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves. Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking. Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad. Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it. Then take off the gloves and wash your hands.

steps.title: Put on gloves
steps.instruction: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves.
steps.source_span: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves.

requirements.vqa_question: Are both of the user's hands wearing gloves?
requirements.observation_hint: Hold both gloved hands up side by side, about 30 cm in front of your chest.

steps.title: Check the wound
steps.instruction: Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.
steps.source_span: Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.

requirements.description: The whole cut is uncovered and in view.
requirements.source_span: Look at the cut on the skin pad.
requirements.vqa_question: Is the whole cut on the skin pad clearly visible, with nothing covering it?
requirements.observation_hint: Hold the skin pad up so the whole cut is in view, in good light.

steps.title: Cover the wound
steps.instruction: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.
steps.source_span: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.

requirements.description: A non-stick pad covers the whole cut.
requirements.source_span: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.
requirements.vqa_question: Is the cut on the skin pad completely covered by a white pad?
requirements.observation_hint: Show the skin pad from above so all edges of the white pad are visible.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.instruction: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it. Then take off the gloves and wash your hands.
steps.source_span: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it. Then take off the gloves and wash your hands.

requirements.description: The wrapper is inside the sealed zip bag.
requirements.source_span: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.
requirements.vqa_question: Is there a closed plastic bag with a wrapper inside it?
Are both of the user's hands bare, without gloves?
requirements.observation_hint: Hold both bare hands up side by side, about 30 cm in front of your chest.

completion_note: Call your nurse if the wound becomes more red, swollen or warm, starts leaking, or if you get a fever.
